subject.note: What makes two rows the same individual (animal, eye, patient, sample). Required — guessing it wrong pairs the wrong rows.

condition.note: The column holding the two states being compared. Required.

value.note: Numeric measure. Blank = the first numeric column.

levels.note: "before, after" — which two conditions, in order. Required when the column has more than two.

group.note: Optional. Clusters subjects along x, one before/after pair per group.

summary.note: The bold line over the subjects.

sig_test.note: Paired by design — an unpaired test would discard the pairing the figure is built on.

catalog.summary: Paired before/after chart — one line per subject between two conditions, coloured by whether it rose or fell. Shows what a bar chart of the same data destroys: whether individuals moved together, or half rose while half fell to leave the group mean unchanged. Tested with a paired t-test or Wilcoxon signed-rank, and reports how many subjects went each way.
